purpose: 把固定RemoteClient已有的私有活动状态以低基数OTLP gauge暴露，先关闭detached与late-release活动量缺口

patch_artifacts.contents: 从隔离候选实际Git差异生成，包含两个Gauge实现和一个detached生命周期快照测试

minimal_edit_points: io-metrics: add two bounded-label gauge helper functions beside existing remote lock counters
remote_locker: update detached gauge after admission increment and detached task decrement
remote_locker: update late-release gauge after admission increment and completion decrement
io-metrics tests: assert both gauge names and peer labels are emitted
remote_locker tests: add a single-thread async runtime metric snapshot assertion for detached gauge return-to-zero; late-release runtime value remains open
explicitly_not_changed: deferred release schedule and server lease behavior
RustFS default metrics or production configuration
DSH, media service, recommendation service, or storage selection
invariants: peer label is the existing configured endpoint and must not contain credentials
each admitted detached task increments once and decrements once; budget-rejected RPCs never increment the in-flight gauge
a completed task must leave its peer gauge at zero even when late completion handling fails
the gauge is diagnostic state, not a lease ownership proof or cluster-wide atomic snapshot
deferred release remains an explicit unresolved signal until it receives its own bounded gauge
validation_plan: run io-metrics unit tests with the existing local recorder
run remote_locker timeout, detached-budget and late-release tests on the fixed source
run the same original-versus-candidate cancellation contract without changing load parameters
capture OTLP gauge snapshots during load, recovery, cleanup and before shutdown
compare gauge convergence separately from top/locks and cumulative counters

rustfs_binary_check.warnings: fixed upstream unused/dead-code warnings; no candidate error
